$comment: Images the owner placed in public/ and asked to be added (2026-10-01). Identity is the owner's filename, read literally; where the file's own Adobe Stock title names a different catalogue species, the file goes to that species instead (three files) and the reason is recorded. Uploaded through the ordinary species-media pipeline (re-encoded, metadata stripped, private bucket) by `npm run species:images -- owner-upload`.
